questions.question: Which statement best reflects the lesson’s guidance?

Every Salesforce org lives inside three sets of constraints: governor limits that cap what a single Apex transaction can do, API request allocations that cap how many external calls an org gets per day, and storage limits that cap how much data and how many files you can keep.
The system architect's job is to treat limits as part of the specification, not as an afterthought.
This lesson defines the three families of limits, gives the concrete numbers that matter, and shows how to plan around them with bulkification, batching, and monitoring.
